title: Tick Tock Clock
blurb: An alternating tick-tock, two seconds of pure deadline pressure. This is the sound quiz shows play while someone sweats over an answer, and the sound editors reach for when a decision is taking too long. Loop it under any moment of hesitation and the moment becomes ten times funnier. Sharp synthesized clicks, no background noise, free to download.
origin: Original synthesis of a mechanical clock's alternating tick and tock.
